fusions.name: Joint Nip
fusions.desc: A quick bite at the joints that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Spike
fusions.desc: Throws a spike that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignores its armour and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Tempered Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Settled Mettle
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
